title: Rooftop run
subtitle: Mind the gaps and the water tanks.

sections.name: Street
sections.note: The street under the terraces: the rooster struts ahead; tap to chase.

sections.name: FirstRoofs
sections.note: Up the ladder onto the roofs, a run along them, and off the end.

sections.name: FirstGap
sections.note: Two rows with a 2 m gap between: jump it. A feather above the gap.

sections.name: FirstTank
sections.note: A water tank on the roofs: jump it like a pot stack.

sections.name: Clothesline
sections.note: Back on the lane: a clothesline across it. Slide under.

sections.name: Breather
sections.note: A breather: mangoes and a chilli.

sections.name: LongRun
sections.note: The long run: eleven houses and two tanks, a gap, four more houses.

sections.name: PotsHens
sections.note: A pot stack, then the hens' basket.

sections.name: GapTanks
sections.note: Three rows, two gaps, a tank on the first two.

sections.name: Clotheslines
sections.note: Two clotheslines: slide, slide. A feather over the second.

sections.name: ChilliLane
sections.note: A chilli to win back ground.

sections.name: RoofTrain
sections.note: Four rows in a train: jump, jump, jump; a feather above the tank.

sections.name: PotsPair
sections.note: Two pot stacks.

sections.name: Mischief
sections.note: A pot stack; the rooster knocks the hens' basket into the lane; a clothesline.

sections.name: LongTanks
sections.note: The long run again, three tanks, a gap; down, and pots.

sections.name: ChilliStraight
sections.note: A chilli and a long straight.

sections.name: ClothesPotsHens
sections.note: Clothesline, pots, the hens' basket.

sections.name: GapRun
sections.note: Four rows, three gaps, a tank in the third row.

sections.name: HensPots
sections.note: The hens' basket, then pots.

sections.name: FinalChilli
sections.note: The last chilli.

sections.name: LastRoofs
sections.note: The last long run: two tanks, a gap, a tank, a gap; down, a clothesline.

sections.name: LastTest
sections.note: Pots, a clothesline, the hens' basket, pots.

sections.name: OpenStreet
sections.note: The street opens out: if he is still ahead, he gets away at 700 m.
